macros.name: makeform
macros.doc: Based on the questions appearing in your document, QCM has the ability to generate a “form” (a grid that your students will have to fill in), and a “mask” (the same grid, only with correct answers properly checked in).

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: If you have defined a title, make it appear by calling \maketitle after the beginning of your document.

macros.name: questionsepspace
macros.doc: \questionsepspace is the amount of extra vertical space to put between each question block.

macros.name: questiontitlefont
macros.doc: The \questiontitlefont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for each question title.

macros.name: questiontitlespace
macros.doc: \questiontitlespace is the amount of extra vertical space to put after the question title (and before the questions’ text).

macros.name: titlefont
macros.doc: The \titlefont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for the title.

macros.name: titlespace
macros.doc: \titlespace is the amount of extra vertical space to put after the title.

envs.name: correction
envs.doc: To typeset explanations below the questions, use the correction environment (no argument). The contents of this environment is displayed only in correction mode.
